userStories.title: Extend HealthDataSource interface with readDailyIntake and readBasalMetabolicRate
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the shared HealthDataSource interface to declare intake and BMR queries so platform implementations can provide them.
acceptanceCriteria: Add suspend fun readDailyIntake(startDate: String, endDate: String): HealthResult<List<DailyIntake>> to HealthDataSource interface in composeApp/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/mettyoung/fitbro/data/health/HealthDataSource.kt
Add suspend fun readBasalMetabolicRate(startDate: String, endDate: String): HealthResult<List<Metabolism>> to HealthDataSource interface — returned Metabolism objects must have tef = 0.0
Android actual (HealthDataSource.android.kt) updated to include both new methods — may stub with HealthResult.Failure(HealthDataError.NotAvailable) until US-002
iOS actual (HealthDataSource.ios.kt) updated to include both new methods — may stub with HealthResult.Failure(HealthDataError.NotAvailable) until US-003
Typecheck passes (Android + iOS)

userStories.title: Implement NutritionRecord + BasalMetabolicRateRecord reading in Android Health Connect
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Android HealthDataSource to read calorie intake from NutritionRecord and BMR from BasalMetabolicRateRecord.
acceptanceCriteria: readDailyIntake: uses AggregateGroupByPeriodRequest with NutritionRecord.ENERGY_TOTAL metric and Period.ofDays(1); returns DailyIntake(date, totalCalories) per day; days with no data omitted

readBasalMetabolicRate: uses readRecords(BasalMetabolicRateRequest(...)) for date range; averages record.basalMetabolicRate.inKilocaloriesPerDay per calendar day; returns Metabolism(date, bmr, tef=0.0) per day; days with no data omitted

Permission check: if HealthPermission.getReadPermission(NutritionRecord::class) or HealthPermission.getReadPermission(BasalMetabolicRateRecord::class) not granted, return HealthResult.Failure(HealthDataError.PermissionDenied)
AndroidManifest.xml updated: add android.permission.health.READ_NUTRITION and android.permission.health.READ_BASAL_METABOLIC_RATE to both uses-permission block and health-connect queries block
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement dietary energy + basal energy reading in iOS HealthKit
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the iOS HealthDataSource to read calorie intake from HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryEnergyConsumed and BMR from HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBasalEnergyBurned.
acceptanceCriteria: readDailyIntake: uses HKSampleQuery for HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryEnergyConsumed; sums samples per calendar day using HKUnit.kilocalorieUnit(); returns DailyIntake(date, totalCalories) per day; days with no data omitted

readBasalMetabolicRate: uses HKSampleQuery for HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBasalEnergyBurned; averages samples per calendar day in kcal/day; returns Metabolism(date, bmr, tef=0.0) per day; days with no data omitted
requestAuthorizationToShareTypes updated to include both new quantity types in its readTypes set alongside existing activeEnergyBurned
K/N 2.3.21 pattern: explicit imports required for ObjC category methods (e.g. import platform.HealthKit.kilocalorieUnit)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Health Connect permission gate on Android
userStories.description: As a user, I need the app to request Health Connect permissions before showing the dashboard so data can actually be fetched.
acceptanceCriteria: Required permissions set defined as a constant: setOf READ_ACTIVE_CALORIES_BURNED, READ_NUTRITION, READ_BASAL_METABOLIC_RATE where each is HealthPermission.getReadPermission(RecordClass::class)
On Android: before showing dashboard, check healthConnectClient.permissionController.getGrantedPermissions() — if not all required permissions granted, show permission gate screen
Permission gate screen shows explanation text (FitBro needs Health Connect access to read calorie data) and a Grant Permissions button
Grant Permissions button launches HealthPermission.getHealthPermissionsActivityContract() using rememberLauncherForActivityResult
On activity result: if all permissions now granted, proceed to dashboard; if still missing, show Permissions required message with retry button
On iOS: no permission gate screen — HealthKit authorization requested inline on first query (already handled in HealthDataSource.ios.kt)
Typecheck passes
